Understanding Web Page Archiving

Archiving web pages locally is a common need for researchers and developers. This article explains the basic concepts behind saving pages as documents.

Why archive locally

Local archives do not depend on remote services, and they keep working even when the original page goes offline. See the archiving guide for more details.

  • No server upload required
  • Works offline
  • Full user control
Save what you see, keep what you need.
